label: Epistemic authority finite controls
meaning: Explicit Unit-subject finite frames reusing the existing count/reassurance profiles. They witness that thin F6, presentation and the ordinary-role definition are jointly satisfiable with the goal-relative account, an indifference alternative and the absence of any preference-independent reason, and that each premise of the answerability argument can fail while the other holds. Analyst interpretations, not actual normative facts or possibility claims.
